# CJ Browning Insurance Agency

> Local Farmers Insurance agency based in Scottsdale, Arizona, offering property & casualty (P&C) insurance statewide for individuals, families, and businesses.

CJ Browning Insurance Agency is an independently owned and operated Farmers Insurance agency based in Scottsdale, AZ. It is licensed to serve clients throughout Arizona — including Scottsdale, Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Paradise Valley, Fountain Hills, Cave Creek, Tucson, and Flagstaff — helping them get insured through Farmers Insurance products.

## Services

- Auto insurance
- Homeowners insurance
- Renters insurance
- Condo insurance
- Landlord insurance
- Umbrella insurance
- Business / commercial insurance
- Motorcycle insurance
- Boat & RV insurance
- Flood insurance
